Messages.Author: Wouter Kuyper
Messages.Body:
Suppose i was to build a deck that really only starts working when you
found that one card.

(i am thinking of Alexandra-alastor-eye-illusions-multirush)

How many Alastors would you play? How many eyes? How many and what
kind of cycle?

W

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
"Wouter Kuyper" <Wouter...@yahoo.com> schreef in bericht
news:44a2da05.0407...@posting.google.com...


I'd play some 8-9 Alastor and 2 Eyes.

You can search your Eye with Alastor and one is all you ever need. The
second is in case you draw it in your opening hand.

Aside from the obvious Dreams, I'd play Aura Reading as cycle, since

Messages.Author: Darby Keeney
Messages.Body:
Wouter...@yahoo.com (Wouter Kuyper) wrote in message news:<44a2da05.0407...@posting.google.com>...


1/10 of your 90-card deck should be Alastor. You'll have a roughly
54% chance of having an Alastor in your opening hand. By the time you
get through 15 cards, you're 82% likely to have hit Alastor. When you
get to 20 cards, that probabilility increases to 90%.

3 copies of Eye of Hazimel are needed. You're 22% likely to get one
in your opening hand, but that isn't a help. You're only 6% likely
to have found two Eyes by the time you get through 20 cards (90%
probable to have found at least 1 Alastor).

I would stick mostly with combat-oriented card cycling in this deck.
Two cards come to mind - Aura Reading and Infernal Pursuit. I would
include both, as the inferior functions of each will also be useful.
I think the [cel] Infernal Pursuit will be more useful than the [aus]
Aura Reading, so I would include a grater proportion of IP. Also, its
CEL effects stack, so you can be pretty sure to get to an Alastor in a
hurry if that is really your goal.

What I'm not sure I understand is how Alexandra will multi-rush. She
can't untap herself. Perhaps your intent is to use some other vampire
as the rusher and they will benefit from Alexandra's untap ability -
but this is awfully slow to get started and risks not being able to
push the vote through without PRE modifiers (which you will not want
to carry in a multi-rush combat deck.)

But, assuming you're committed to this, a solid multi-rusher would be
Joaquin Murietta (AUS CEL obf pre qui, 1 additional strike in the 1st
round, +1 gun damage at long). You really should include 1-2 Assault
Rifles and Disguised Weapons if you go this way. Heck, Joaquin might
even choose to Alastor for the Rifle, then equip the Eye the old
fashioned way after you get going.

Good luck.
Darby

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
> What I'm not sure I understand is how Alexandra will multi-rush. She
> can't untap herself. Perhaps your intent is to use some other vampire
> as the rusher and they will benefit from Alexandra's untap ability -
> but this is awfully slow to get started and risks not being able to
> push the vote through without PRE modifiers (which you will not want
> to carry in a multi-rush combat deck.)

Simple, while Alexandra can't untap herself, her Illusion can.

He'll make up a crypt of 12x (or more) Alexandra's, ensuring that when
he plays Illusions of the Kindred he gets another Alexandra. That
Alexandra will then use her special ability to untap the original one
(as far as I know she can do that during combat as well, unless there's
some errata/clarification on that).

Of course the illusion won't have the Eye, so I'm not sure how you
intend to do a lot of damage with her discipline spread.

Carrion crows and a lot of presses? It also has a huge problem with SCE
as you can't play Psyche! with the illusion.
